title: Thamizh
desc: Following an altercation with some dangerous goons, a man confronts a gangster and joins hands with his adversary to defeat him.

title: Maya Bazaar
desc: A businessman dearly loves his daughter and wants to ensure that she is always protected. Meanwhile, his close friend and business partner hatches a plot to usurp his wealth.

title: Parijatham
desc: Surendhar's mother tells him that she has found him a bride. Before the couple can meet, his mother dies in an accident. He sets out to find the woman his mother wanted him to marry.

title: Unnale Unnale
desc: During a flight to Melbourne, Karthik befriends Deepika. Upon arrival in Australia, Karthik discovers that Deepika is a colleague of his former lover, Jhansi.

title: Janakiraman
desc: Two brothers remain sworn to bachelorhood. However, chaos arises when a man tries to get them married to his daughters.
